info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 74h online + 3h offline + 1h TE + 2h PE + 70h self-study
info.description: Business intelligence deal with collecting, organizing, interpreting, and reporting on data to help organizations make informed business decisions. Other tasks include measuring performance, tracking revenue or spending, and monitoring progress. Students’ll get introduced to BI tools and platforms and key technical skills required for an entry-level job. After the course, students’ll be prepared for jobs like business intelligence analyst, business intelligence engineer, business intelligence developer, and more.
info.studentTasks: Students complete the online courses MOOC1-MOOC3 and get certifications for MOOC1-MOOC3 to be allowed to take Final Exam
info.note:
1. 'Students complete the online courses MOOC1-MOOC3 and get certifications for MOOC1 - MOOC3 to be allowed to take Final Exam

2. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100%

3. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & FR>=5

(FR = min (10, (Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus)
